analysis: Reviewed four new files in libs/darkbloom-cluster TensorParallel. LoadAgreement.swift (1-56) hashes canonical JSON of the schema, the admission fingerprint and fields, including prefixCache on/off at line 47, so peer ranks refuse mismatched configs. Peer-side enforcement and the data-plane keying (ClusterDataPlaneAgreement) are outside the supplied evidence. LocalPair.swift (1-90) is an in-process oracle/test harness: it does a condition-variable all-sum with preconditions, a 600s deadline that crashes on timeout, and no network surface. Model.swift: load() reads config.json and model.safetensors.index.json. It rejects file names containing '/' and requires a .safetensors suffix (line 68), which blocks path traversal from the index. assemble checks keys and shapes against the plan, and duplicate keys throw. generate() validates the token range and recordTop<=64. These checks constrain local operator-supplied weights but give no integrity guarantee; weight substitution stays covered by pre-existing T-012/T-027. PagedSession.swift: the session init checks capacity and that the prefix committedTokens is below promptCount, and Prefix.adopts checks geometry. prefill/decode check the frontier, the vocabulary range and pages. Batch decode requires distinct open sessions. retire runs on failure paths, and the host drain check frees pages. Prefix capture (Gemma4TensorParallelPrefixCapture) and restore extend the prefix-cache surface (T-041/SEC-035) to TP Gemma on resident and SSD tiers. Not visible here: whether capture/restore keys on the coordinator cacheSalt, uses the HMAC SSD naming, and applies the per-donation gate and TTL. Integration should verify that Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix and capture preserve cacheSalt scope and the KVCacheSSD encryption path. Also unseen: the cross-host collective transport, the 'sealed all-sum' and JACCL, which carry activations derived from consumer plaintext (A-001) between ranks on possibly different Macs. The threat model has no boundary for an inter-provider TP data plane, and integration should confirm that it is authenticated and encrypted and documented. No concrete regression is visible in these units.
